description: Tab-separated export of every table of 'Core loss database_v2.accdb' (the original, byte-for-byte, is ../files/). This is a derived intermediate, not an original file: Python has no maintained reader for the MS Access ACE format.
tool: Jackcess 4.0.5 (com.healthmarketscience.jackcess, Apache-2.0) with commons-lang3 3.14.0 and commons-logging 1.3.0 from Maven Central; tools/accdb_export/Dump.java
format: first line = column names; one row per line; values as Jackcess Object.toString() (FLOAT columns: shortest decimal of the stored float32); tabs and newlines inside values replaced by spaces
